Plugin.Name: Flotilla Agent
Plugin.Overview:
Forwards your Unraid notifications to your iPhone as push notifications, end-to-end encrypted.
The agent hooks Unraid's own notification system as a notify agent, so anything that already raises a notification — parity checks, disk errors, SMART warnings, array events, your own User Scripts calling `notify` — is delivered to your phone. It adds a settings page under Settings for pairing and configuration, and a heartbeat so your phone can tell the difference between "nothing is wrong" and "the server is gone".
Event content is sealed with ChaCha20-Poly1305 on your server before it leaves your LAN. The encryption key exists in exactly two places: this server's config file and the paired phone's Keychain. The relay that forwards the push cannot read your notifications — it only ever sees ciphertext — and neither can Apple. Your Unraid API key, hostname and other server-local secrets are never sent anywhere.
MIT licensed. No runtime dependencies beyond what Unraid already ships (bash, curl, jq); the plugin itself is plain PHP and bash. Uninstalling removes the notify agent, the cron entry and the config directory.
The companion iOS app (Flotilla) is a separate, optional paid app — the plugin is free and open source, and this repo is everything that runs on your server.
